title: Intake, milestone close and refusal recovery (tmux, fake forge): mdstack feedback files one runtime-blocker card per failure class with Source, expected/actual and redaction, comments on a duplicate class and files nothing on an unreadable card list; a closed milestone is taken only when its sweep starts, not while the researchers cap queues it; the milestone-close sweep files one card per class, routes crew: and repo: scope, adds evidence to a matching card and links a matching lesson; a provider safety refusal is parked once as needs-owner and never retried, and a worker's refusal status wakes the coordinator once with the window kept

import json, os, sys
# Plays the forge's issue store for A27: open, closed and the closed milestone's issues (issue-list-all.json).
g, repo = os.environ["CAMPAIGN_GH_DIR"], sys.argv[1]


def issue(n, title, body="", labels=(), milestone=None, comments=(), reason=None):
    return {"number": n, "title": title, "body": body, "labels": [{"name": x} for x in labels], "milestone": milestone,
            "assignees": [], "url": "https://example.invalid/%s/issues/%d" % (repo, n), "stateReason": reason,
            "createdAt": "2025-12-30T00:00:00Z", "comments": list(comments)}


def note(login, body):
    return {"author": {"login": login}, "body": body, "createdAt": "2025-12-31T00:00:00Z"}


def card(cls, source, scope):
    return ("**Source:** %s\n**Trigger:** reviewer-changes\n**Failure class:** %s\n**Proposed fix:** for triage\n"
            "**Scope:** %s - seeded\n**Decision:** pending\n" % (source, cls, scope))


m3 = {"title": "M3"}
json.dump([issue(1, "Triage log 2026-01-01", labels=["triage:log"]),
           issue(9, "Exploit walkthrough for the CI runner"),
           issue(12, "Add a colour to mdstack status"),
           issue(41, "intake: owner-steer on %s#99" % repo, card("owner-steer", repo + "#99", "crew:"))],
          open(os.path.join(g, "issue-list-open.json"), "w"), indent=1)
json.dump([issue(40, "intake: review-rework on %s#11" % repo, card("review-rework", repo + "#11", "repo:"))],
          open(os.path.join(g, "issue-list-closed.json"), "w"), indent=1)
json.dump([issue(11, "Precheck misses a rename", milestone=m3, comments=[note("sandbox-reviewer", "<!-- crew:v1 role=reviewer "
                 "pass=review pr=21 sha=abc round=1 verdict=changes -->")]),
           issue(13, "Status colours", milestone=m3, comments=[note("sandbox-coordinator", "<!-- crew:v1 role=coordinator "
                 "pass=steer cmd=scope issue=13 -->")]),
           issue(14, "Train lock timeout", labels=["crew:escalated"], milestone=m3),
           issue(15, "Doctor drift check", milestone=m3, reason="REOPENED"),
           issue(16, "Clean item", milestone=m3)],
          open(os.path.join(g, "issue-list-all.json"), "w"), indent=1)

cat > {state_dir}/sweep.py <<'PY'
import json, os, re, subprocess, sys
# Plays Riley's sweep (templates/runtimes/tmux/researcher.md Milestone close, Never) for a stub engine: no model.
# The fake forge keeps each post in issue-list-open.json; a number in state/refuse is a provider safety refusal.
repo, sweep, src = sys.argv[1:4]
crew_repo = repo.split("/")[0] + "/eng-crew"
st, gd = os.environ["CREW_STATE"], os.environ["CAMPAIGN_GH_DIR"]
state = os.path.dirname(gd)
brief = open(os.environ["CREW_BRIEF"]).read()
item_line = re.search(r"^- Item: (.*)$", brief, re.M)[1]
wt = re.search(r"^- Worktree: (.*)$", brief, re.M)[1]
rec = json.load(open(os.path.join(st, "runs", os.environ["CREW_ID"] + ".json")))
who = "— 🔬 Riley (Researcher) · %s · %s\n" % (rec["harness"], rec["model"])
openf, closedf, allf = (os.path.join(gd, "issue-list-%s.json" % s) for s in ("open", "closed", "all"))
items, closed = json.load(open(openf)), json.load(open(closedf))
url = lambda r, n: "https://example.invalid/%s/issues/%s" % (r, n)
fields = lambda c: [dict(kv.split("=", 1) for kv in m.split() if "=" in kv) for m in re.findall(r"<!-- crew:v1 ([^>]*?) -->", c["body"])]
refuse = open(os.path.join(state, "refuse")).read().split() if os.path.exists(os.path.join(state, "refuse")) else []


def save():
    json.dump(items, open(openf, "w"), indent=1)


def gh(*args, body=None):
    return subprocess.run(["gh", *args], input=body, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


def post(n, body, r=repo):
    gh("issue", "comment", str(n), "-R", r, "--body-file", "-", body=body)
    for i in items + closed:
        if i["number"] == n:
            i.setdefault("comments", []).append({"author": {"login": "sandbox-coordinator"}, "body": body,
                                                 "createdAt": "2026-01-01T%s:00:00Z" % sweep[-5:-3]})
    save()
    json.dump(closed, open(closedf, "w"), indent=1)


def label(n, name):
    gh("issue", "edit", str(n), "-R", repo, "--add-label", name)
    next(i for i in items if i["number"] == n)["labels"].append({"name": name})
    save()


lines = []
CLASSES = [("review-rework", "repo:", lambda i: any(f.get("verdict") == "changes" for c in i["comments"] for f in fields(c))),
           ("owner-steer", "crew:", lambda i: any(f.get("pass") == "steer" for c in i["comments"] for f in fields(c))),
           ("escalation", "crew:", lambda i: any(x["name"] == "crew:escalated" for x in i["labels"])),
           ("near-miss-reopen", "repo:", lambda i: i.get("stateReason") == "REOPENED")]
for ms in re.findall(r"(\S+) milestone (\d+) \(([^)]*)\)", item_line.split("milestone close: ", 1)[-1]) if "milestone close: " in item_line else []:
    issues = json.loads(gh("issue", "list", "-R", ms[0], "--milestone", ms[2], "--state", "all", "--json",
                           "number,title,labels,comments,stateReason"))
    lessons = [os.path.join("docs/lessons", f) for f in sorted(os.listdir(os.path.join(wt, "docs/lessons")))] \
        if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(wt, "docs/lessons")) else []
    for cls, scope, hit in CLASSES:
        found = sorted(i["number"] for i in issues if hit(i))
        if not found:
            continue
        source, others = "%s#%d" % (repo, found[0]), ", ".join("%s#%d" % (repo, n) for n in found[1:]) or "none"
        lesson = [p for p in lessons if re.search(r"^(### .*|- \*\*Fix:\*\*.*)\b%s\b" % re.escape(cls),
                                                  open(os.path.join(wt, p)).read(), re.M | re.I)]
        card = [i for i in items + closed if re.search(r"^\*\*Failure class:\*\* %s$" % re.escape(cls), i.get("body") or "", re.M)
                and re.search(r"^\*\*Source:\*\* %s\b" % re.escape(source), i.get("body") or "", re.M)]
        if lesson:
            lines.append("- %s: lesson %s matches; linked, no card (%s)" % (cls, lesson[0], source))
        elif card:
            post(card[0]["number"], "Seen again at the close of %s (%s): %s; others: %s.\n\n%s" % (ms[2], url(*ms[:2]), source, others, who))
            lines.append("- %s: evidence added to #%d" % (cls, card[0]["number"]))
        else:
            r = crew_repo if scope == "crew:" else repo
            body = ("**Source:** %s (%s)\n**Trigger:** milestone-close\n**Failure class:** %s\n**Proposed fix:** for triage\n"
                    "**Scope:** %s - from the %s close; others: %s (triage: confirm or promote)\n**Lesson:** none yet\n"
                    "**Findings entry:** none yet\n**Decision:** pending\n\n%s") % (
                source, url(repo, found[0]), cls, scope, ms[2], others, who)
            gh("issue", "create", "-R", r, "--title", "intake: %s on %s" % (cls, source), "--body-file", "-", body=body)
            n = max(i["number"] for i in items + closed + json.load(open(allf))) + 1
            items.append({"number": n, "title": "intake: %s on %s" % (cls, source), "body": body, "labels": [], "assignees": [],
                          "milestone": None, "url": url(r, n), "comments": []})
            save()
            lines.append("- %s: filed %s#%d (%s)" % (cls, r, n, scope))
queue = json.load(open(os.path.join(st, "triage", "queue.json")))["items"]
for e in queue:
    n = int(e["ref"].split("#")[1])
    open(os.path.join(state, "model.log"), "a").write("call #%d %s\n" % (n, sweep))
    if str(n) in refuse:
        outcome, band, note = "needs-owner", "P3", "Refused by the provider (safety filter): parked for the owner; no retry or reframe."
        label(n, "needs-owner")
    else:
        outcome, band, note = "classify", "P2", "Applied: nothing (shadow)\nProposed: classify P2"
    post(n, "[Riley/triage] #%d: %s %s\n\n%s\nused: none\n\n<!-- crew:v1 role=researcher pass=triage issue=%d decision=%s "
         "priority=%s mode=shadow sweep=%s -->\n%s" % (n, outcome, band, note, n, outcome, band, sweep, who))
    lines.append("- %s: #%d %s" % (outcome, n, band) + (" (refused by the provider)" if str(n) in refuse else ""))
log = next(i["number"] for i in items if any(x["name"] == "triage:log" for x in i["labels"]))
post(log, "[Riley/triage-log] %s\n\n%s\n\n<!-- crew:v1 role=researcher pass=triage-log sweep=%s tokens=unknown -->\n%s"
     % (sweep, "\n".join(lines) or "- nothing", sweep, who))
open(os.environ["CREW_STATUS"], "a").write("done: triage %s\n" % url(repo, log))
